scope: recorded G+ geometry observations; no failed observation records

sampling.composition: independent global32 plus lineage-specific32, NOT first64 of one sequence
sampling.discretization: D_j[floor(u_j * len(D_j))], no interpolation or rounding
sampling.design_seed: uint32(first 8 hex chars of SHA256(UTF8 canonical JSON [method, global_seed, design_specific, lineage_id]))

quality.G: complete geometry and full recorded flow under frozen qualification checks
quality.C: G and OPEN=0 and SHORT=0 and checker_unknown=0

budget.elapsed_scope: selected attempt; earlier failures not included

Ncut_intermetal.meaning: deduplicated intermetal cut shapes, excluding contacts/V0
